subject: Study 4040: Inquiry about Resting HR
body:
Hi, I am emailing in regards to resting HR collection from Fitbit devices. I am currently running a study (ID: 4040) on Avicenna, and the first few participants finished their 2 weeks of ambulatory assessment and so I am now looking through their data. One of the primary outcomes we are interested in is daily resting heart rate (in addition to intraday minute-by-minute heart rate). When we initially spoke with the sales team about using Avicenna, they said we would be able to get resting HR from Avicenna. However, I'm not able to see it in the data. Based on Fitbit's website, it should be in the Daily Activity Summary, but it's not there. I was hoping you could provide some clarity, as we're really hoping to have resting HR. Thank you!
 
Best,
Elise
--
Elise (Cummings) Adams, M.A.

Ph.D. Candidate

Clinical Psychology

Stony Brook University

subject: Study 4040: Inquiry about Resting HR
body:
Hi Elise
I went through the data currently available on the platform and I think there was a miscommunication here. I'm sorry for the confusion and inconvenience that it caused. To clarify, while there is the possibility to collect resting heart rate data, but it needs to be implemented specifically for you if you need it. It will come with a development cost attached to it. I can provide you with more details and the approximate costs if you want to move forward with it.
Please let me know once you have decided.
Best regards,
Amin
